name: ai-mystery-room
description: AI-powered web application where users create and solve mysteries generated using Gemini

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && node --test tests/phase0.test.ts tests/phase2.test.ts tests/phase3.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
